commitments.detail: Replace air filter as a precautionary measure.
Perform three purge cycles to ensure all contaminants are removed.
Quarantine the first 100 units produced post-restart for quality inspection.
Replace air filter as part of standard restart procedure.
Perform three purge cycles before restarting production.
Quarantine and inspect 100 units produced before and after the restart for defects.
Conduct a round with maintenance and quality to ensure safety and compliance.
Conduct a round with maintenance and quality before authorizing production.
